entities.summary: Jaume Francesc Folc de Cardona i de Gandia was a Catholic cardinal. He was Bishop of Vich (1445-1459), Girona (1459-1461) and Urgell (1461-1466), then in the Principality of Catalonia. He was chosen as a cardinal by Pope Pius II on 18 December 1461.
